paper: Distributed Dominating Set Approximations beyond Planar Graphs

sources.claim: ∇₁(G) is the maximum edge density |E(H)|/|V(H)| over nonempty depth-1 minors H of G. Locally embeddable graphs exclude K₃,t as a depth-1 minor for some fixed integer t≥3.
The modified algorithm requires an additional supplied integer c bounding the edge density of every depth-1 minor. It uses c in the local threshold; it does not compute global density locally.
Approximation factor 6c²t+(2t+5)c+4 under the density and excluded-depth-1-minor assumptions.

decision.approximation: Keep the source polynomial in c, because c is a supplied integer upper bound and need not equal the possibly fractional ∇₁(G).
inlineSetting: K₃,ₜ excluded as a depth-1 minor (t ≥ 3)
decision.densityDefinition: Define ∇₁(G) in the canonical parameters section.
decision.ceilingChoice: c=⌈∇₁(G)⌉ is valid when supplied; a larger known integer upper bound is also allowed, with the guarantee evaluated at the supplied c.
decision.rounds: The existing ≤6 communication-round phase audit is unchanged; c and t influence local thresholds or analysis.
decision.provenance: Original polynomial, source theorem and raw source fields remain accessible. Canonical fact IDs prevent repeated conditions.
